library(shiny)

## Plot style (after the lecture-notes figures) ###############################

plot_font <- "Gillius ADF" # falls back to the default sans if not installed
plot_res <- 110 # raise for bigger text on a projector
lines_lwd <- 2.2
axis_lwd <- 1
ref_lwd <- 1.2
ref_col <- "grey60"
point_cex <- 1.1
curve_lty <- c(1, 2, 3) # curve 1 solid, 2 dashed, 3 dotted
iso_col <- "grey40" # Lotka-Volterra isoclines
iso_lwd <- 1.5
field_col <- "grey62" # phase-plane arrows
user_col <- "grey45" # optional reference lines set in the sidebar
user_lty <- 5 # long dashes: distinct from dotted zero/K lines and the curves
fig_png_res <- 300 # downloaded PNGs: pixels per inch (same layout as on screen)
fig_png_max_cm <- 40 # wider PNGs get too big to draw in the browser (webR); PDF has no limit

# the font family actually used (a PDF device without Cairo cannot use plot_font)
plot_family <- function() getOption("popdyn.family", plot_font)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

## Models ######################################################################

exp_n <- function(t, n0, r) n0 * exp(r * t)
log_n <- function(t, n0, r, k) k / (1 + (k / n0 - 1) * exp(-r * t))

# Predator-prey, general form used by all four predator-prey pages:
#   dN/dt = rN(1 - N/K) - aNP/(1 + ahN),   dP/dt = eaNP/(1 + ahN) - mP
# K = Inf gives exponential prey growth, h = 0 a linear (type I) response;
# both together give the basic Lotka-Volterra model.
pp_rates <- function(n, p, pars) {
  with(as.list(pars), {
    f <- a * n / (1 + a * h * n) # prey eaten per predator
    list(
      dn = r * n * (1 - n / K) - f * p,
      dp = e * f * p - m * p
    )
  })
}

# Solved for log N and log P: populations stay positive, and with a large K
# (paradox of enrichment) the prey can fall to 1e-100 and below while the
# predators peak. In N and P that is stiff (thousands of times more steps,
# and values below the solver's absolute tolerance come out wrong); in logs
# it is smooth, and small values keep their relative accuracy.
# A population starting at 0 stays at 0, so the other one has a closed form.
lv_solve <- function(n0, p0, pars, t_max, n_out = 4001) {
  r <- pars[["r"]]
  a <- pars[["a"]]
  e <- pars[["e"]]
  m <- pars[["m"]]
  K <- pars[["K"]]
  h <- pars[["h"]]
  tt <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = n_out)
  if (n0 <= 0 || p0 <= 0) {
    n <- if (n0 <= 0) 0 * tt else if (is.finite(K)) log_n(tt, n0, r, K) else exp_n(tt, n0, r)
    p <- if (p0 <= 0) 0 * tt else p0 * exp(-m * tt)
    return(data.frame(t = tt, N = n, P = p))
  }
  f <- function(u) { # same model as pp_rates(), per capita, for u = log(N, P)
    n <- exp(u[1])
    fr <- a / (1 + a * h * n) # prey eaten per predator, per prey
    c(r * (1 - n / K) - fr * exp(u[2]), e * fr * n - m)
  }
  out <- exp(ode_dp5(f, log(c(n0, p0)), tt, rtol = 0, atol = 1e-8)) # error in logs = relative error
  data.frame(t = tt, N = out[, 1], P = out[, 2])
}

# ODE solver: adaptive Dormand-Prince 5(4), the method behind MATLAB's ode45.
# Written out here so the app needs no ODE package and also runs in the
# browser with shinylive (webR has no deSolve). Values at `times` come from
# cubic Hermite interpolation between accepted steps. As lv_solve() calls it,
# N and P are accurate to ~1e-5 relative error, and the Lotka-Volterra
# quantity is conserved to ~1e-5, so neutral cycles close.
ode_dp5 <- function(f, y0, times, rtol = 1e-8, atol = 1e-10, max_steps = 2e5) {
  n_out <- length(times)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, n_out, length(y0))
  out[1, ] <- y0
  t <- times[1]
  t_end <- times[n_out]
  y <- y0
  k1 <- f(y)
  # starting step (after Hairer, Norsett & Wanner)
  sc <- atol + rtol * abs(y)
  d0 <- sqrt(mean((y / sc)^2))
  d1 <- sqrt(mean((k1 / sc)^2))
  h <- if (d0 < 1e-5 || d1 < 1e-5) 1e-6 else 0.01 * d0 / d1
  j <- 2 # next output row
  steps <- 0
  while (t < t_end && j <= n_out) {
    steps <- steps + 1
    if (steps > max_steps) stop("too many steps")
    h <- min(h, t_end - t)
    k2 <- f(y + h * (k1 / 5))
    k3 <- f(y + h * (3 / 40 * k1 + 9 / 40 * k2))
    k4 <- f(y + h * (44 / 45 * k1 - 56 / 15 * k2 + 32 / 9 * k3))
    k5 <- f(y + h * (19372 / 6561 * k1 - 25360 / 2187 * k2 + 64448 / 6561 * k3 -
      212 / 729 * k4))
    k6 <- f(y + h * (9017 / 3168 * k1 - 355 / 33 * k2 + 46732 / 5247 * k3 +
      49 / 176 * k4 - 5103 / 18656 * k5))
    y_new <- y + h * (35 / 384 * k1 + 500 / 1113 * k3 + 125 / 192 * k4 -
      2187 / 6784 * k5 + 11 / 84 * k6)
    k7 <- f(y_new)
    err <- h * (71 / 57600 * k1 - 71 / 16695 * k3 + 71 / 1920 * k4 -
      17253 / 339200 * k5 + 22 / 525 * k6 - 1 / 40 * k7)
    sc <- atol + rtol * pmax(abs(y), abs(y_new))
    e_norm <- sqrt(mean((err / sc)^2))
    if (!all(is.finite(y_new)) || !is.finite(e_norm)) { # overflow: retry smaller
      h <- h / 5
      if (h < 1e-12 * max(1, abs(t))) stop("step size too small")
      next
    }
    if (e_norm <= 1) { # accept the step, fill the outputs it covers
      t_new <- t + h
      j2 <- findInterval(t_new, times) # last output at or before t_new
      if (j2 >= j) {
        s <- (times[j:j2] - t) / h
        out[j:j2, ] <- outer(2 * s^3 - 3 * s^2 + 1, y) + outer((s^3 - 2 * s^2 + s) * h, k1) +
          outer(-2 * s^3 + 3 * s^2, y_new) + outer((s^3 - s^2) * h, k7)
        j <- j2 + 1
      }
      t <- t_new
      y <- y_new
      k1 <- k7 # first same as last
    }
    h <- h * min(5, max(0.2, if (e_norm > 0) 0.9 * e_norm^(-1 / 5) else 5))
  }
  if (j <= n_out) out[j:n_out, ] <- rep(y, each = n_out - j + 1)
  out
}

# Discrete time (after the lecture C programs 1_DIS_EXP*.c and 2_DIS_LOG.c).
# R is the mean number of offspring per individual per generation.
# Overlapping generations (the C programs): parents survive,
#   N[t+1] = N[t] + R N[t]. With noise, offspring are Poisson(R), so R >= 0
#   and populations never shrink; without noise R may go down to -1
#   (a net loss).
# Non-overlapping generations: parents die after breeding, N[t+1] = R N[t],
#   R >= 0; below 1 the population shrinks, and with noise it can die out.
#   demographic noise: every individual draws its own number of offspring;
#   environmental noise: one draw per generation, shared by all individuals.
# The sum of N independent Poisson(R) draws is one Poisson(N R) draw, which
# gives the same distribution without looping over individuals.
dexp_run <- function(n0, r, t_max, noise = c("none", "demographic", "environmental"),
                     overlapping = TRUE) {
  noise <- match.arg(noise)
  kept <- if (overlapping) 1 else 0 # parents still alive next generation
  n <- numeric(t_max + 1)
  n[1] <- n0
  for (i in seq_len(t_max)) {
    offspring <- switch(noise,
      none = r * n[i],
      demographic = rpois_big(r * n[i]),
      environmental = n[i] * stats::rpois(1, r)
    )
    n[i + 1] <- kept * n[i] + offspring
  }
  n
}

# Poisson draw that stays exact for moderate means and uses the normal
# approximation beyond where rpois() is reliable
rpois_big <- function(mu) {
  if (mu < 1e9) stats::rpois(1, mu) else max(0, round(stats::rnorm(1, mu, sqrt(mu))))
}

# Logistic:  N[t+1] = N[t] + R N[t] (1 - N[t]/K); negative sizes become 0
dlog_run <- function(n0, r, k, t_max) {
  n <- numeric(t_max + 1)
  n[1] <- n0
  for (i in seq_len(t_max)) n[i + 1] <- max(0, n[i] + r * n[i] * (1 - n[i] / k))
  n
}

## Helpers #####################################################################

# Evaluates expr with the random numbers of `seed`, then puts R's random
# stream back as it was, so later draws (e.g. new seeds) stay random
with_seed <- function(seed, expr) {
  old <- if (exists(".Random.seed", globalenv(), inherits = FALSE)) get(".Random.seed", globalenv())
  on.exit(if (is.null(old)) {
    rm(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv())
  } else {
    assign(".Random.seed", old, envir = globalenv())
  })
  set.seed(seed)
  expr
}

nice_step <- function(x) {
  p <- 10^floor(log10(x))
  m <- x / p
  (if (m < 1.5) 1 else if (m < 3.5) 2 else if (m < 7.5) 5 else 10) * p
}

## Static plots (R) ############################################################

# optional horizontal (hline) and vertical (vline) reference lines; NULL = none
draw_user_lines <- function(hline = NULL, vline = NULL) {
  if (length(hline)) abline(h = hline, lwd = ref_lwd, lty = user_lty, col = user_col)
  if (length(vline)) abline(v = vline, lwd = ref_lwd, lty = user_lty, col = user_col)
}

# k: carrying capacity per shown curve (NULL = no K lines).
# right_mar is fixed per page so the plot frame never shifts.
# discrete: time in generations; a tick at every generation when there is room.
draw_growth <- function(t_max, ylim, k = NULL, right_mar = 1.6,
                        hline = NULL, vline = NULL, discrete = FALSE) {
  par(
    mar = c(3.3, 3.8, 2.0, right_mar),
    mgp = c(0, 0.6, 0),
    tcl = -0.3,
    family = plot_family()
  )
  plot(NULL, axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE, xlim = c(0, t_max), ylim = ylim)
  usr <- par("usr")

  abline(h = 0, lwd = ref_lwd, lty = 3, col = ref_col)
  if (!is.null(k)) {
    groups <- split(seq_along(k), k) # curves sharing a K share a line
    for (g in groups) {
      kv <- k[g[1]]
      if (kv < usr[3] || kv > usr[4]) next
      abline(h = kv, lwd = ref_lwd, lty = 3, col = ref_col)
      lab <- if (length(groups) == 1) {
        quote(italic(K))
      } else {
        bquote(italic(K)[.(paste(g, collapse = ","))])
      }
      mtext(lab, side = 4, at = kv, las = 1, line = 0.4, col = "grey35")
    }
  }
  draw_user_lines(hline, vline)

  every_gen <- discrete && t_max <= 12 && par("pin")[1] / t_max >= 0.4
  axis(1, at = if (every_gen) 0:t_max, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd)
  axis(2, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd)
  box(bty = "l", lwd = axis_lwd)
  mtext(expression("Time, " * italic(t)), side = 1, line = 2.0)
  mtext(expression("Population size, " * italic(N)), side = 2, line = 2.3)
}

lv_frame <- function(xlim, ylim, mar) {
  par(mar = mar, mgp = c(0, 0.6, 0), tcl = -0.3, family = plot_family())
  plot(NULL, axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim)
}

lv_axes <- function(xlab, ylab) {
  axis(1, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd)
  axis(2, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd)
  box(bty = "l", lwd = axis_lwd)
  mtext(xlab, side = 1, line = 2.0)
  mtext(ylab, side = 2, line = 2.3)
}

draw_lv_time <- function(t_max, ylim, hline = NULL, vline = NULL) {
  lv_frame(c(0, t_max), ylim, mar = c(3.3, 3.8, 2.0, 1.6))
  abline(h = 0, lwd = ref_lwd, lty = 3, col = ref_col)
  draw_user_lines(hline, vline)
  lv_axes(expression("Time, " * italic(t)), "Population size")
}

# direction of flow on a grid, all arrows the same length on screen
draw_field <- function(pars, xlim, ylim, cell_in = 0.36) {
  pin <- par("pin")
  usr <- par("usr")
  nx <- max(6, min(28, round(pin[1] / cell_in)))
  ny <- max(5, min(22, round(pin[2] / cell_in)))
  g <- expand.grid(
    N = xlim[1] + (seq_len(nx) - 0.5) * diff(xlim) / nx,
    P = ylim[1] + (seq_len(ny) - 0.5) * diff(ylim) / ny
  )
  d <- pp_rates(g$N, g$P, pars)
  dn <- d$dn
  dp <- d$dp
  sx <- pin[1] / diff(usr[1:2])
  sy <- pin[2] / diff(usr[3:4]) # inches per unit
  len <- sqrt((dn * sx)^2 + (dp * sy)^2)
  ok <- len > 1e-12
  half <- 0.3 * min(pin[1] / nx, pin[2] / ny)
  ux <- dn[ok] / len[ok] * half # half-arrow, back in data units
  uy <- dp[ok] / len[ok] * half
  arrows(g$N[ok] - ux, g$P[ok] - uy, g$N[ok] + ux, g$P[ok] + uy,
    length = 0.05, angle = 25, lwd = 1, col = field_col
  )
}

# Prey isocline (dN/dt = 0, N > 0):  P = (r/a)(1 - N/K)(1 + ahN)
# Predator isocline (dP/dt = 0, P > 0):  N = m / a(e - mh)   (m/ea when h = 0)
draw_isoclines <- function(pars, xlim) {
  usr <- par("usr")
  in_x <- function(x) x >= usr[1] && x <= usr[2]
  in_y <- function(y) y >= usr[3] && y <= usr[4]
  with(as.list(pars), {
    p_int <- r / a # prey isocline at N = 0
    if (is.infinite(K) && h == 0) { # horizontal: label at the right
      abline(h = p_int, lwd = iso_lwd, col = iso_col)
      if (in_y(p_int)) {
        mtext("r/a", side = 4, at = p_int, las = 1, line = 0.4, font = 3, col = "grey30")
      }
    } else { # curve from N = 0 to K
      nn <- seq(0, min(K, usr[2]), length.out = 400)
      lines(nn, p_int * (1 - nn / K) * (1 + a * h * nn), lwd = iso_lwd, col = iso_col)
    }
    if (e > m * h) { # predators can persist
      n_iso <- m / (a * (e - m * h))
      abline(v = n_iso, lwd = iso_lwd, col = iso_col)
      if (in_x(n_iso)) {
        mtext(if (h == 0) "m/ea" else "m/a(e − mh)",
          side = 3, at = n_iso,
          line = 0.2, font = 3, col = "grey30"
        )
      }
    }
  })
}

# Intercepts of a curved prey isocline: r/a on the P axis, K on the N axis.
# The browser draws them above the trajectory, on a white patch.
intercept_labels <- function(pars) {
  with(as.list(pars), {
    if (is.infinite(K) && h == 0) {
      return(list())
    }
    rising <- h * a - 1 / K > 0 # slope at N = 0
    labs <- list(list(
      text = "r/a", x = 0, y = r / a,
      adj = if (rising) c(-0.3, 1.5) else c(-0.3, -0.6)
    ))
    if (is.finite(K)) labs[[2]] <- list(text = "K", x = K, y = 0, adj = c(-0.5, -0.6))
    labs
  })
}

draw_lv_phase <- function(xlim, ylim, pars, show_iso = FALSE, show_field = FALSE,
                          readout = FALSE, hline = NULL, vline = NULL) {
  # top margin matches the time plot when both are shown; the read-out
  # (phase plane alone) sits above the m/ea label
  lv_frame(xlim, ylim, mar = c(3.3, 3.8, if (readout) 2.8 else 2.0, 2.6))
  abline(h = 0, v = 0, lwd = ref_lwd, lty = 3, col = ref_col)
  if (show_field) draw_field(pars, xlim, ylim)
  if (show_iso) draw_isoclines(pars, xlim)
  draw_user_lines(hline, vline)
  lv_axes(expression("Prey, " * italic(N)), expression("Predators, " * italic(P)))
}

## Overlay: what moves, drawn in the browser ###################################

ov_style <- list(
  res = plot_res, ps = 12, lwd = lines_lwd, pointCex = point_cex,
  font = plot_font
)

# Sends the full trajectories once; the browser cuts them at the current t.
# outputs: one entry per plot, saying which columns to draw and how.
# When only the settings changed (a view or a check box), the trajectories
# are not sent again: the browser keeps the last ones for this time slider.
send_overlay <- function(session, time_id, data, outputs, discrete = FALSE) {
  data <- lapply(data, function(v) signif(as.numeric(v), 7))
  # kept for downloads, which R draws itself
  for (o in outputs) {
    assign(o$id, list(cfg = o, data = data, discrete = discrete),
      envir = session$userData$overlays
    )
  }
  msg <- list(time = time_id, style = ov_style, discrete = discrete, outputs = outputs)
  sent <- session$userData$ov_sent
  if (!identical(sent[[time_id]], data)) {
    msg$data <- data
    assign(time_id, data, envir = sent)
  }
  session$sendCustomMessage("ov-data", msg)
}

# Clears what the browser draws on these plots (e.g. when the model cannot be
# solved), so no stale trajectory stays on screen.
clear_overlay <- function(session, time_id, ids) {
  for (id in ids) {
    if (exists(id, envir = session$userData$overlays, inherits = FALSE)) {
      rm(list = id, envir = session$userData$overlays)
    }
  }
  if (exists(time_id, envir = session$userData$ov_sent, inherits = FALSE)) {
    rm(list = time_id, envir = session$userData$ov_sent)
  }
  session$sendCustomMessage("ov-clear", list(ids = as.list(ids)))
}

ov_output <- function(id, height, class = NULL) {
  div(
    class = paste(c("ov-wrap", class), collapse = " "),
    style = if (height == "100%" && is.null(class)) "height: 100%;",
    plotOutput(id, height = height),
    tags$canvas(class = "ov-canvas", `data-for` = id)
  )
}

## Downloads: the overlay drawn by R ###########################################

# Numbers as the browser writes them: 4 significant digits, whole numbers exact
fmt_num <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) return("NaN")
    if (is.infinite(v)) return(if (v > 0) "Infinity" else "-Infinity")
    if (v == 0) return("0")
    if (v == round(v) && abs(v) < 1e7) return(sprintf("%.0f", v))
    if (abs(v) >= 1e7) return(sprintf("%.3e", v))
    if (abs(v) < 1e-6) { # as JavaScript writes it, e.g. 1.2e-7
      s <- sub("\\.?0+e", "e", sprintf("%.3e", signif(v, 4)))
      return(sub("e([-+])0*", "e\\1", s))
    }
    trimws(formatC(signif(v, 4), digits = 4, format = "fg"))
  }, character(1))
}

# point markers, as in the browser: 'dot'/'filled' solid, 'open' white inside,
# 'hollow' see-through, 'tri' open triangle
ov_marker <- function(kind, x, y, scale, col, lwd, ...) {
  if (!length(x)) return(invisible())
  cex <- point_cex * scale
  switch(kind,
    dot = ,
    filled = points(x, y, pch = 16, cex = cex, col = col, ...),
    open = points(x, y, pch = 21, cex = cex, col = col, bg = "white", lwd = lwd, ...),
    hollow = points(x, y, pch = 1, cex = cex, col = col, lwd = lwd, ...),
    tri = points(x, y, pch = 24, cex = 0.84 * cex, col = col, bg = "white", lwd = lwd, ...)
  )
  invisible()
}

# R's version of render() in player_js: draws, on the plot just drawn by the
# static function, what the browser shows at time t. Sizes follow the browser
# code, converted from screen pixels to inches. cfg, D: as sent by send_overlay.
# Returns the widths (inches) the texts need, measured from the plot region's
# left edge: the title (inside the plot) and the read-outs (shrunk as far as
# they go; they may run on into the margin), so downloads can refuse a
# too-narrow width.
draw_overlay <- function(cfg, D, t, disc) {
  usr <- par("usr")
  pin <- par("pin")
  ux <- diff(usr[1:2]) / pin[1] # user units per inch
  uy <- diff(usr[3:4]) / pin[2]
  x_at <- function(xin) usr[1] + xin * ux # inches right of the plot's left edge
  y_at <- function(yin) usr[4] + yin * uy # inches above the plot's top edge
  pt <- 1 / 72
  px <- 1 / plot_res # one screen pixel
  ps <- par("ps")
  cex_of <- function(size) size / (ps * pt)
  wid <- function(s, size, font = 1) strwidth(s, units = "inches", cex = cex_of(size), font = font)
  txt_col <- "#404040"

  tt <- D$t
  n <- length(tt)
  tmax <- tt[n]
  t <- max(tt[1], min(tmax, t))
  lo <- max(which(tt <= t + 1e-9))
  hi <- if (disc) lo else min(lo + 1, n)
  f <- if (tt[hi] > tt[lo]) (t - tt[lo]) / (tt[hi] - tt[lo]) else 0
  at <- function(v) v[lo] + (v[hi] - v[lo]) * f

  series <- cfg$series
  show <- !(isTRUE(cfg$blank0) && t <= 0)
  lw <- lines_lwd
  mark_lwd <- function(k) max(96 / plot_res, k * lw) # at least one screen pixel
  rad <- 0.375 * point_cex * 0.6 * ps * pt # radius of pch 16, inches

  # curves up to t, the first series on top; markers at each generation so far
  for (s in rev(seq_along(series))) {
    se <- series[[s]]
    if (isFALSE(se$draw)) next
    xs <- D[[se$x]]
    ys <- D[[se$y]]
    col <- se$col %||% "black"
    lty <- se$lty %||% 0
    if (show && lty != 0) {
      lines(c(xs[seq_len(lo)], if (!disc) at(xs)), c(ys[seq_len(lo)], if (!disc) at(ys)),
        col = col, lwd = lw * (se$lwd %||% 1), lty = lty
      )
    }
    if (disc && !is.null(se$pch)) {
      k <- se$ptScale %||% 1
      ov_marker(se$pch, xs[seq_len(lo)], ys[seq_len(lo)], k, col, mark_lwd(0.55 * k))
    }
  }
  if (!disc) { # continuous time: a dot at the current t
    for (se in series) {
      if (isFALSE(se$draw)) next
      ov_marker("dot", at(D[[se$x]]), at(D[[se$y]]), 1, se$col %||% "black", 1)
    }
  }

  # white halo behind text, as the browser's stroked outline
  halo_text <- function(x, y, s, cex, adj, r = 1.5 * px) {
    for (a in seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 17)[-17]) {
      text(x + r * cos(a) * ux, y + r * sin(a) * uy, s,
        cex = cex, adj = adj, col = "white", xpd = NA
      )
    }
    text(x, y, s, cex = cex, adj = adj, col = txt_col, xpd = NA)
  }

  # values written above the points of one series (discrete pages)
  ls_i <- cfg$labelSeries %||% -1
  if (disc && ls_i >= 0 && show) {
    ls <- series[[ls_i + 1]]
    vfs <- 0.8 * ps * pt
    for (i in seq_len(lo)) {
      y <- D[[ls$y]][i]
      if (y < usr[3] || y > usr[4]) next
      yb <- y + (rad * (ls$ptScale %||% 1) + 0.35 * vfs) * uy
      halo_text(D[[ls$x]][i], yb, fmt_num(y), cex_of(vfs), c(0.5, 0))
    }
  }

  # panel title, top left inside the plot, on a white patch
  title_room <- 0
  if (!is.null(cfg$title)) {
    tfs <- 0.95 * ps * pt
    tx <- 0.02 * pin[1]
    tb <- -(0.03 * pin[2] + 0.8 * tfs) # baseline, below the top edge
    tw <- wid(cfg$title, tfs)
    title_room <- (tw + 4 * px) / 0.98
    rect(x_at(tx - 4 * px), y_at(tb - 0.3 * tfs), x_at(tx + tw + 4 * px), y_at(tb + 0.85 * tfs),
      col = grDevices::rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.85), border = NA, xpd = NA
    )
    text(x_at(tx), y_at(tb), cfg$title, adj = c(0, 0), cex = cex_of(tfs), col = "#4d4d4d", xpd = NA)
  }

  # isocline intercepts, above the trajectory on a white patch
  lfs <- ps * pt
  th <- 0.72 * lfs
  for (lb in cfg$labels %||% list()) {
    if (lb$x < usr[1] || lb$x > usr[2] || lb$y < usr[3] || lb$y > usr[4]) next
    tw <- wid(lb$text, lfs, 3)
    x0 <- lb$x - lb$adj[1] * tw * ux
    yb <- lb$y - lb$adj[2] * th * uy
    rect(x0 - 0.15 * lfs * ux, yb - 0.3 * th * uy, x0 + (tw + 0.15 * lfs) * ux, yb + 1.3 * th * uy,
      col = "white", border = NA, xpd = NA
    )
    text(x0, yb, lb$text, adj = c(0, 0), font = 3, col = "#4d4d4d", xpd = NA)
  }

  # read-outs in the top margin: t on the left, current values on the right
  fs <- 0.9 * ps * pt
  cw <- 0.15 * 0.9 # legend character width, inches
  base <- (cfg$line %||% 0.5) * 0.2 + 0.2 * fs # baseline, above the top edge
  put <- function(s, x, size, font = 1, dy = 0) { # returns where the text ends
    text(x_at(x), y_at(base - dy), s,
      adj = c(0, 0), cex = cex_of(size), font = font, col = txt_col, xpd = NA
    )
    x + wid(s, size, font)
  }
  t_right <- 0
  t_str <- function(v) if (disc) sprintf("%d", as.integer(round(v))) else sprintf("%.2f", v)
  if (isTRUE(cfg$showT)) {
    x1 <- put(" = ", put("t", 0, fs, 3), fs)
    put(t_str(if (disc) tt[lo] else t), x1, fs)
    t_right <- x1 + wid(t_str(tmax), fs)
  }
  items <- cfg$items
  if (!(isTRUE(cfg$values) && show && length(items))) {
    return(invisible(c(title = title_room, readout = t_right)))
  }

  vals <- function(it) {
    se <- series[[it$series + 1]]
    D[[if (identical(it$coord, "x")) se$x else se$y]]
  }
  sample_of <- function(it) (it$lty %||% 0) != 0 || !is.null(it$pch)
  idx <- unique(c(seq(1, n, by = max(1, floor(n / 400))), n))
  slots <- vapply(items, function(it) { # widest value each item will ever show
    max(wid(paste0(fmt_num(vals(it)[idx]), it$suffix %||% ""), fs))
  }, numeric(1))
  layout_at <- function(sz) { # shrunk (to 60 % at most) when the plot is too narrow
    k <- sz / fs
    seg <- (if (isTRUE(cfg$seg > 0)) cfg$seg else 2.2) * cw * k
    w <- vapply(seq_along(items), function(j) {
      it <- items[[j]]
      sub <- it$sub %||% ""
      (if (sample_of(it)) seg + 0.6 * cw * k else 0) +
        wid(it$label, sz, if (isTRUE(it$plain)) 1 else 3) +
        (if (nzchar(sub)) wid(sub, 0.7 * sz) else 0) + wid(" = ", sz) + slots[j] * k
    }, numeric(1))
    list(sz = sz, k = k, seg = seg, gap_s = 0.6 * cw * k, gap_i = 1.4 * cw * k, w = w,
      total = sum(w) + 1.4 * cw * k * (length(w) - 1))
  }
  avail <- pin[1] - (t_right + 1.5 * cw)
  lay <- layout_at(fs)
  if (lay$total > avail && avail > 0) lay <- layout_at(fs * max(0.6, avail / lay$total))
  x <- max(pin[1] - lay$total, t_right + 1.5 * cw)
  for (j in seq_along(items)) {
    it <- items[[j]]
    start <- x
    if (sample_of(it)) {
      sy <- base + 0.33 * fs
      if ((it$lty %||% 0) != 0) {
        segments(x_at(x), y_at(sy), x_at(x + lay$seg), y_at(sy),
          lwd = 0.8 * lw, lty = it$lty, col = "black", xpd = NA
        )
      }
      if (!is.null(it$pch)) {
        ov_marker(it$pch, x_at(x + lay$seg / 2), y_at(sy), 0.85, "black", mark_lwd(0.4), xpd = NA)
      }
      x <- x + lay$seg + lay$gap_s
    }
    xv <- put(it$label, x, lay$sz, if (isTRUE(it$plain)) 1 else 3)
    sub <- it$sub %||% ""
    if (nzchar(sub)) xv <- put(sub, xv, 0.7 * lay$sz, dy = 0.25 * fs * lay$k)
    xv <- put(" = ", xv, lay$sz)
    put(paste0(fmt_num(at(vals(it))), it$suffix %||% ""), xv, lay$sz)
    x <- start + lay$w[j] + lay$gap_i
  }
  invisible(c(title = title_room, readout = t_right + 1.5 * cw + layout_at(0.6 * fs)$total))
}

# Smallest figure width (inches) at which every plot keeps a plot region at
# least fig_min_region wide and high, its title fits inside it, and its
# read-outs end before the next plot's region starts (or the figure's edge).
# Text keeps its size in points, so the margins and texts measured on a copy
# drawn at screen size hold at any width.
fig_min_region <- 1 # inches
min_fig_width <- function(draws, overlays, w, h, t) {
  n <- length(draws)
  mai <- matrix(0, n, 4) # margins of each plot, inches
  title <- readout <- numeric(n)
  measure <- function() {
    if (n > 1) layout(matrix(seq_len(n), 1), widths = w)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      draws[[i]]()
      ov <- overlays[[i]]
      if (!is.null(ov)) {
        room <- draw_overlay(ov$cfg, ov$data, t, ov$discrete)
        title[i] <<- room[["title"]]
        readout[i] <<- room[["readout"]]
      }
      mai[i, ] <<- par("mai")
    }
  }
  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  on.exit(unlink(path))
  plotPNG(measure, path, width = sum(w), height = max(h), res = plot_res)
  # each plot's share of the width must hold its margins and plot region,
  # and its read-outs may run on into the next plot's left margin
  spill <- c(mai[-1, 2], 0)
  fig_in <- pmax(
    mai[, 2] + mai[, 4] + pmax(fig_min_region, title),
    mai[, 2] + readout - spill
  )
  height_in <- max(mai[, 1] + mai[, 3]) + fig_min_region # scales with the width
  1.05 * max(fig_in * sum(w) / w, height_in * sum(w) / max(h)) # other devices measure text a little differently
}

# Writes the plots in view (left to right) to a PNG or PDF file, with the
# shape they have on screen (w, h: screen pixels). width_in: width of the
# figure in inches (NULL: as on screen); text keeps its size in points.
# draws: functions drawing each plot's static part; overlays: what the
# browser shows on each. A width too narrow for the plots in view stops
# with a condition of class "fig_too_narrow" saying the smallest width.
write_figure <- function(path, fmt, draws, overlays, w, h, t, width_in = NULL) {
  w_in <- sum(w) / plot_res
  h_in <- max(h) / plot_res
  if (!is.null(width_in)) {
    if (width_in < w_in) { # narrower than on screen: will it still fit?
      min_w <- min_fig_width(draws, overlays, w, h, t)
      if (width_in < min_w) {
        stop(structure(class = c("fig_too_narrow", "error", "condition"), list(
          message = sprintf(
            "Too narrow for the plots in view: give at least %s cm, or leave the width empty.",
            format(ceiling(2 * min_w * 2.54) / 2)
          ),
          call = NULL
        )))
      }
    }
    h_in <- h_in * width_in / w_in
    w_in <- width_in
  }
  draw_all <- function() {
    if (length(draws) > 1) layout(matrix(seq_along(draws), 1), widths = w)
    for (i in seq_along(draws)) {
      draws[[i]]()
      ov <- overlays[[i]]
      if (!is.null(ov)) draw_overlay(ov$cfg, ov$data, t, ov$discrete)
    }
  }
  if (fmt == "png") {
    plotPNG(draw_all, path,
      width = round(w_in * fig_png_res), height = round(h_in * fig_png_res),
      res = fig_png_res
    )
  } else {
    cairo_ok <- isTRUE(capabilities("cairo")) &&
      !inherits(try(grDevices::cairo_pdf(path, width = w_in, height = h_in), silent = TRUE), "try-error")
    if (!cairo_ok) { # the plain PDF device only knows its own fonts
      grDevices::pdf(path, width = w_in, height = h_in)
      op <- options(popdyn.family = "")
      on.exit(options(op), add = TRUE)
    }
    on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
    draw_all()
  }
  invisible(path)
}

# step: slider step; NULL picks a fine one for continuous time, 1 = generations
time_controls <- function(id, t_max, step = NULL) {
  btn <- function(action, ico, title, cls = NULL) {
    tags$button(

    )

    sliderInput(id, "Time",
      min = 0, max = t_max, value = 0,
      step = if (is.null(step)) nice_step(t_max / 500) else step,
      ticks = FALSE, width = "100%"
    ),
    div(
      class = "player",
      btn("start", "backward-fast", "Back to t = 0"),
      btn("back", "backward-step", "Step back"),
      btn("reverse", "play", "Play backwards", "fa-flip-horizontal"),
      btn("pause", "pause", "Pause"),
      btn("play", "play", "Play forwards"),

          title = "Width of the saved figure, in cm (empty: as on screen)"

        lapply(c("png", "pdf"), function(fmt) {
          tags$button(
            type = "button", class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm fig-dl",
            title = paste("Save the figure as it is now, as", toupper(fmt)),
            `data-target` = id, `data-fmt` = fmt,
            icon("download"), toupper(fmt)
          )

      tags$select(
        class = "form-select form-select-sm player-speed", `data-target` = id,
        title = "Playback speed",
        tags$option(value = "20", "Slow"),
        tags$option(value = "10", selected = NA, "Normal"),
        tags$option(value = "5", "Fast")
      )
    )
  )
}

player_js <- HTML(r"(
$(function () {
  var players = {};      // time slider id -> playback state
  var TNOW = {};         // time slider id -> exact current t (the slider shows it rounded)
  var OV = {};           // plot output id -> {cfg, data, time, map}
  var STYLE = null;
  var quiet = false;     // true while this code moves a slider itself

  function sl(id) { return $('#' + id).data('ionRangeSlider'); }
  function dec(step) { return Math.max(0, Math.ceil(-Math.log10(step)) + 1); }
  function snap(o, v) {
    v = Math.min(o.max, Math.max(o.min, v));
    return +(Math.round((v - o.min) / o.step) * o.step + o.min).toFixed(dec(o.step));
  }
  function tOf(id) {
    if (TNOW[id] !== undefined) return TNOW[id];
    var s = sl(id); return s ? s.result.from : 0;
  }
  function isTime(id) { return $('.player-btn[data-target="' + id + '"]').length > 0; }

  // ---- time slider ----------------------------------------------------------

  function tellShiny(id) {
    var $el = $('#' + id);
    quiet = true; $el.data('immediate', true);
    try { $el.trigger('change'); } finally { $el.data('immediate', false); quiet = false; }
  }

  function showSlider(id, v) {             // move the handle only
    var s = sl(id); if (!s) return;
    quiet = true;
    try { s.update({ from: snap(s.options, v) }); } finally { quiet = false; }
  }

  function setT(id, v) {
    var s = sl(id); if (!s) return;
    v = snap(s.options, v);
    TNOW[id] = v;
    showSlider(id, v);
    tellShiny(id);
    redrawTime(id);
  }

  function niceStep(x) {
    var p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(x))), m = x / p;
    return (m < 1.5 ? 1 : m < 3.5 ? 2 : m < 7.5 ? 5 : 10) * p;
  }

  var DISC = {};         // time slider ids that count whole generations

  function stepBy(id, dir) {
    var o = sl(id).options, cur = tOf(id);
    var h = DISC[id] ? 1 : niceStep((o.max - o.min) / 20);
    var next = dir > 0 ? (Math.floor(cur / h + 1e-6) + 1) * h
                       : (Math.ceil(cur / h - 1e-6) - 1) * h;
    setT(id, next);
  }

  function mark(id, dir) {
    var b = $('.player-btn[data-target="' + id + '"]');
    b.removeClass('active');
    if (dir > 0) b.filter('[data-action="play"]').addClass('active');
    if (dir < 0) b.filter('[data-action="reverse"]').addClass('active');
  }

  function stop(id) {
    var p = players[id];
    if (p) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(p.raf);
      delete players[id];
      showSlider(id, tOf(id));
      tellShiny(id);
    }
    mark(id, 0);
  }

  // one step per screen refresh; t advances with real time
  function play(id, dir) {
    if (players[id] && players[id].dir === dir) { stop(id); return; }
    stop(id);
    var o = sl(id).options, cur = tOf(id);
    if (dir > 0 && cur >= o.max - o.step / 2) cur = o.min;
    if (dir < 0 && cur <= o.min + o.step / 2) cur = o.max;
    var p = players[id] = { dir: dir, last: null, pos: cur, shown: 0 };
    mark(id, dir);
    function frame(now) {
      if (players[id] !== p) return;
      var o = sl(id).options;
      if (p.last !== null) {
        var dur = +$('.player-speed[data-target="' + id + '"]').val() || 10;
        p.pos += p.dir * (o.max - o.min) * (now - p.last) / 1000 / dur;
      }
      p.last = now;
      var done = p.dir > 0 ? p.pos >= o.max : p.pos <= o.min;
      if (done) p.pos = p.dir > 0 ? o.max : o.min;
      TNOW[id] = p.pos;
      redrawTime(id);
      if (done || now - p.shown > 50) { showSlider(id, p.pos); p.shown = now; }
      if (done) { stop(id); return; }
      p.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    p.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  $(document).on('click', '.player-btn', function () {
    var id = $(this).data('target'), a = $(this).data('action');
    this.blur();  // only the playing direction stays highlighted
    if (a === 'play') return play(id, 1);
    if (a === 'reverse') return play(id, -1);
    stop(id);
    var o = sl(id).options;
    if (a === 'start') setT(id, o.min);
    if (a === 'end') setT(id, o.max);
    if (a === 'back') stepBy(id, -1);
    if (a === 'fwd') stepBy(id, 1);
  });

  // dragging the slider (or Shiny changing its range) moves time directly
  $(document).on('change', 'input.js-range-slider', function () {
    if (quiet || players[this.id] || !isTime(this.id)) return;
    TNOW[this.id] = sl(this.id).result.from;
    redrawTime(this.id);
  });

  // grabbing the slider or switching pages pauses playback
  $(document).on('mousedown touchstart', '.irs', function () {
    var id = $(this).closest('.shiny-input-container').find('input.js-range-slider').attr('id');
    if (players[id]) stop(id);
  });
  $(document).on('shown.bs.tab', function (e) {
    if ($(e.target).closest('.navbar').length) Object.keys(players).forEach(stop);
    setTimeout(redrawAll, 30);
  });
  $(window).on('resize', redrawAll);

  // ---- overlay --------------------------------------------------------------

  function redrawTime(tid) {
    Object.keys(OV).forEach(function (id) { if (OV[id].time === tid) drawOverlay(id); });
  }
  function redrawAll() { Object.keys(OV).forEach(drawOverlay); }

  var DATA = {};         // time slider id -> trajectories last sent
  Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('ov-data', function (msg) {
    STYLE = msg.style;
    DISC[msg.time] = !!msg.discrete;
    if (msg.data) DATA[msg.time] = msg.data;   // no data: same as last time
    msg.outputs.forEach(function (o) {
      var ov = OV[o.id] = OV[o.id] || {};
      ov.cfg = o; ov.data = DATA[msg.time]; ov.time = msg.time; ov.slots = null;
      ov.discrete = !!msg.discrete; ov.key = null;
      drawOverlay(o.id);
    });
  });
  Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('ov-clear', function (msg) {
    msg.ids.forEach(function (id) {
      if (OV[id]) { OV[id].cfg = null; OV[id].key = null; drawOverlay(id); }
    });
  });

  // each new static image carries its coordinate map (as used for plot clicks)
  $(document).on('shiny:value', function (e) {
    if (!document.querySelector('canvas.ov-canvas[data-for="' + e.name + '"]')) return;
    var ov = OV[e.name] = OV[e.name] || {};
    var cm = e.value && e.value.coordmap;
    if (cm && cm.panels && cm.panels.length) {
      var p = cm.panels[0];
      ov.map = { d: $.extend({}, p.domain), r: $.extend({}, p.range),
                 w: cm.dims.width, h: cm.dims.height };
    } else {
      ov.map = null;
    }
    ov.key = null;
    setTimeout(function () { drawOverlay(e.name); }, 0);
  });
  $(document).on('shiny:error', function (e) {
    if (OV[e.name]) { OV[e.name].map = null; OV[e.name].key = null; drawOverlay(e.name); }
  });

  function fmtNum(x) {               // like format(signif(x, 4)) in R; whole numbers exact
    if (!isFinite(x)) return String(x);
    if (Number.isInteger(x) && Math.abs(x) < 1e7) return String(x);
    if (Math.abs(x) >= 1e7) {
      var s = x.toExponential(3).split('e'), ex = +s[1];
      return s[0] + 'e' + (ex < 0 ? '-' : '+') + (Math.abs(ex) < 10 ? '0' : '') + Math.abs(ex);
    }
    return String(Number(x.toPrecision(4)));
  }

  function dash(lty, lw) {           // R: lty 2 = "44", lty 3 = "13", in line widths
    return lty === 2 ? [4 * lw, 4 * lw] : lty === 3 ? [1 * lw, 3 * lw] : [];
  }

  // point markers: 'dot' and 'filled' solid, 'open' white inside,
  // 'hollow' see-through (for many overlapping runs), 'tri' open triangle
  function marker(ctx, kind, x, y, r, col, lwl) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (kind === 'tri') {
      var a = 1.3 * r;
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - a); ctx.lineTo(x + 0.866 * a, y + 0.5 * a);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 0.866 * a, y + 0.5 * a); ctx.closePath();
    } else {
      ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    }
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    if (kind === 'dot' || kind === 'filled') { ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fill(); return; }
    if (kind !== 'hollow') { ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.lineWidth = lwl; ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawOverlay(id) {
    var cv = document.querySelector('canvas.ov-canvas[data-for="' + id + '"]');
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!cv || !el) return;
    var ctx = cv.getContext('2d'), ov = OV[id];
    var img = el.querySelector('img');
    var w = img ? img.clientWidth : 0, h = img ? img.clientHeight : 0;
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    if (img && w && h) {
      var wr = cv.parentNode.getBoundingClientRect(), ir = img.getBoundingClientRect();
      cv.style.left = (ir.left - wr.left) + 'px'; cv.style.top = (ir.top - wr.top) + 'px';
    }
    var W = Math.round(w * dpr), H = Math.round(h * dpr);
    if (cv.width !== W || cv.height !== H) {
      cv.width = W; cv.height = H; cv.style.width = w + 'px'; cv.style.height = h + 'px';
    }
    // discrete time: nothing changes between generations, so skip those frames
    if (ov && ov.discrete && ov.cfg && ov.map) {
      var key = Math.floor(tOf(ov.time) + 1e-9) + '|' + W + '|' + H;
      if (key === ov.key) return;
      ov.key = key;
    }
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    if (!ov || !ov.cfg || !ov.data || !ov.map || !STYLE || !w || !h) return;
    render(ctx, ov, tOf(ov.time), w, h);
  }

  function render(ctx, ov, t, w, h) {
    var S = STYLE, cfg = ov.cfg, D = ov.data, m = ov.map, disc = ov.discrete;
    var kx = w / m.w, ky = h / m.h;
    var L = m.r.left * kx, R = m.r.right * kx, T = m.r.top * ky, B = m.r.bottom * ky;
    function keep(v) { return Math.max(-1e5, Math.min(1e5, v)); }   // huge values: stay drawable
    function X(x) { return keep(L + (x - m.d.left) / (m.d.right - m.d.left) * (R - L)); }
    function Y(y) { return keep(B - (y - m.d.bottom) / (m.d.top - m.d.bottom) * (B - T)); }

    var pt = S.res / 72;                     // CSS px per point
    var lw = S.lwd * S.res / 96;             // R line widths are 1/96 inch
    var fs = 0.9 * S.ps * pt;                // read-out text, cex = 0.9
    var lineH = 0.2 * S.res;                 // one margin line
    var cw = 0.15 * S.res * 0.9;             // legend character width
    var family = '"' + S.font + '", sans-serif';

    var tt = D.t, n = tt.length, tmax = tt[n - 1];
    t = Math.max(tt[0], Math.min(tmax, t));
    var lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
    while (hi - lo > 1) { var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (tt[mid] <= t) lo = mid; else hi = mid; }
    var f = tt[hi] > tt[lo] ? (t - tt[lo]) / (tt[hi] - tt[lo]) : 0;
    if (disc) {                          // discrete time: whole generations only
      if (t >= tt[hi]) lo = hi;
      hi = lo; f = 0;
    }
    function at(v) { return v[lo] + (v[hi] - v[lo]) * f; }

    // Series may set col, lwd (x the base width), lty (0 = no line),
    // pch (discrete markers), ptScale, and draw: false (read-out values only).
    // blank0: at t = 0 only the starting dots, no lines or read-outs
    var show = !(cfg.blank0 && t <= 0);
    var rad = 0.375 * S.pointCex * 0.6 * S.ps * pt;       // pch = 19
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(L, T, R - L, B - T); ctx.clip();
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    for (var s = cfg.series.length - 1; s >= 0; s--) {     // first series on top
      var se = cfg.series[s];
      if (se.draw === false) continue;
      var xs = D[se.x], ys = D[se.y], col = se.col || '#000', slw = lw * (se.lwd || 1);
      if (show && se.lty) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = slw; ctx.setLineDash(dash(se.lty, slw));
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(xs[0]), Y(ys[0]));
        for (var i = 1; i <= lo; i++) ctx.lineTo(X(xs[i]), Y(ys[i]));
        if (!disc) ctx.lineTo(X(at(xs)), Y(at(ys)));
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      if (disc && se.pch) {              // a marker at every generation so far
        var r = rad * (se.ptScale || 1), mlw = Math.max(1, 0.55 * lw * (se.ptScale || 1));
        for (var i = 0; i <= lo; i++) marker(ctx, se.pch, X(xs[i]), Y(ys[i]), r, col, mlw);
      }
    }
    if (!disc) {                         // continuous time: a dot at the current t
      cfg.series.forEach(function (se) {
        if (se.draw === false) return;
        marker(ctx, 'dot', X(at(D[se.x])), Y(at(D[se.y])), rad, se.col || '#000', 1);
      });
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // values written above the points of one series (discrete pages)
    if (disc && cfg.labelSeries >= 0 && show) {
      var ls = cfg.series[cfg.labelSeries], vfs = 0.8 * S.ps * pt;
      ctx.font = vfs + 'px "' + S.font + '", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#404040'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.setLineDash([]);
      for (var i = 0; i <= lo; i++) {
        var lx = X(D[ls.x][i]), ly = Y(D[ls.y][i]);
        if (ly < T || ly > B) continue;
        var ty = ly - rad * (ls.ptScale || 1) - 0.35 * vfs, str = fmtNum(D[ls.y][i]);
        ctx.strokeText(str, lx, ty);           // white halo keeps it readable over lines
        ctx.fillText(str, lx, ty);
      }
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }

    // panel title, top left inside the plot, above the curves
    if (cfg.title) {
      var tfs = 0.95 * S.ps * pt, tx = L + 0.02 * (R - L), tyb = T + 0.03 * (B - T) + 0.8 * tfs;
      ctx.font = tfs + 'px "' + S.font + '", sans-serif';
      var ttw = ctx.measureText(cfg.title).width;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)';
      ctx.fillRect(tx - 4, tyb - 0.85 * tfs, ttw + 8, 1.15 * tfs);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4d4d';
      ctx.fillText(cfg.title, tx, tyb);
    }

    // isocline intercepts, above the trajectory on a white patch
    var lfs = S.ps * pt;
    ctx.font = 'italic ' + lfs + 'px ' + family;
    (cfg.labels || []).forEach(function (lb) {
      if (lb.x < m.d.left || lb.x > m.d.right || lb.y < m.d.bottom || lb.y > m.d.top) return;
      var tw = ctx.measureText(lb.text).width, th = 0.72 * lfs;
      var x0 = X(lb.x) - lb.adj[0] * tw, yb = Y(lb.y) + lb.adj[1] * th;
      var px = 0.15 * lfs, py = 0.3 * th;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(x0 - px, yb - th - py, tw + 2 * px, th + 2 * py);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4d4d4d';
      ctx.fillText(lb.text, x0, yb);
    });

    // read-outs in the top margin: t on the left, current values on the right
    var base = T - (cfg.line || 0.5) * lineH - 0.2 * fs;
    var fN = fs + 'px ' + family, fI = 'italic ' + fs + 'px ' + family;
    var fSub = (0.7 * fs) + 'px ' + family;
    function width(str, font) { ctx.font = font; return ctx.measureText(str).width; }
    function text(str, font, x, dy) { ctx.font = font; ctx.fillText(str, x, base + (dy || 0)); return x + ctx.measureText(str).width; }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#404040';

    var tRight = L;
    function tStr(v) { return disc ? String(Math.round(v)) : v.toFixed(2); }
    if (cfg.showT) {
      var x1 = text(' = ', fN, text('t', fI, L));
      text(tStr(disc ? tt[lo] : t), fN, x1);
      tRight = x1 + width(tStr(tmax), fN);             // fixed slot: nothing shifts
    }
    if (!(cfg.values && show && cfg.items.length)) return;

    if (!ov.slots) {                   // widest value each item will ever show
      var step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(n / 400));
      ov.slots = cfg.items.map(function (it) {
        var se = cfg.series[it.series], v = D[it.coord === 'x' ? se.x : se.y], mx = 0;
        var sfx = it.suffix || '';     // e.g. '%'
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i += step) mx = Math.max(mx, width(fmtNum(v[i]) + sfx, fN));
        return Math.max(mx, width(fmtNum(v[n - 1]) + sfx, fN), width(fmtNum(v[0]) + sfx, fN));
      });
    }
    // items: label (italic unless plain), optional line sample (lty) and marker (pch).
    // Laid out at size sz; shrunk (to 60 % at most) when the plot is too narrow.
    function layout(sz) {
      var k = sz / fs, F = {
        N: sz + 'px ' + family, I: 'italic ' + sz + 'px ' + family,
        S: (0.7 * sz) + 'px ' + family
      };
      var seg = (cfg.seg || 2.2) * cw * k, gapS = 0.6 * cw * k, gapI = 1.4 * cw * k;
      var parts = cfg.items.map(function (it, j) {
        var wl = width(it.label, it.plain ? F.N : F.I) + (it.sub ? width(it.sub, F.S) : 0) +
          width(' = ', F.N);
        return { it: it, w: (it.lty || it.pch ? seg + gapS : 0) + wl + ov.slots[j] * k };
      });
      var total = parts.reduce(function (a, p) { return a + p.w; }, 0) + gapI * (parts.length - 1);
      return { k: k, F: F, seg: seg, gapS: gapS, gapI: gapI, parts: parts, total: total };
    }
    var avail = R - (tRight + 1.5 * cw), lay = layout(fs);
    if (lay.total > avail && avail > 0) lay = layout(fs * Math.max(0.6, avail / lay.total));
    var seg = lay.seg, gapS = lay.gapS, gapI = lay.gapI;
    fN = lay.F.N; fI = lay.F.I; fSub = lay.F.S;
    var x = Math.max(R - lay.total, tRight + 1.5 * cw);
    lay.parts.forEach(function (p) {
      var it = p.it, se = cfg.series[it.series], start = x;
      if (it.lty || it.pch) {
        var sy = base - 0.33 * fs;
        ctx.save();
        if (it.lty) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#000'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8 * lw; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.setLineDash(dash(it.lty, 0.8 * lw));
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, sy); ctx.lineTo(x + seg, sy); ctx.stroke();
        }
        if (it.pch) marker(ctx, it.pch, x + seg / 2, sy, 0.85 * rad, '#000', Math.max(1, 0.4 * lw));
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#404040';
        x += seg + gapS;
      }
      var xv = text(it.label, it.plain ? fN : fI, x);
      if (it.sub) xv = text(it.sub, fSub, xv, 0.25 * fs * lay.k);
      xv = text(' = ', fN, xv);
      text(fmtNum(at(D[it.coord === 'x' ? se.x : se.y])) + (it.suffix || ''), fN, xv);
      x = start + p.w + gapI;
    });
  }

  // ---- downloads ------------------------------------------------------------
  // R redraws the plots in view at the current t, at their size on screen,
  // and sends the file back (works the same under shinylive)

  $(document).on('click', '.fig-dl', function () {
    var tid = $(this).data('target'), fmt = $(this).data('fmt');
    this.blur();
    var shown = [];
    Object.keys(OV).forEach(function (id) {
      if (OV[id].time !== tid) return;
      var img = document.querySelector('#' + id + ' img');
      if (!img || !img.offsetParent || !img.clientWidth || !img.clientHeight) return;
      shown.push({ id: id, w: img.clientWidth, h: img.clientHeight,
                   x: img.getBoundingClientRect().left });
    });
    shown.sort(function (a, b) { return a.x - b.x; });
    Shiny.setInputValue('fig_request', {
      time: tid, fmt: fmt, t: tOf(tid), w_cm: parseFloat($('#' + tid + '_figw').val()),
      ids: shown.map(function (p) { return p.id; }),
      w: shown.map(function (p) { return p.w; }),
      h: shown.map(function (p) { return p.h; })
    }, { priority: 'event' });
  });

  Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('fig-file', function (msg) {
    var bin = atob(msg.data), bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: msg.mime }));
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = msg.name;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 10000);
  });

  // ---- reset and preset buttons ---------------------------------------------
  // Values go in as if typed; Shiny sends the changed ones together, so R
  // recomputes once.

  function setInput(id, v) {
    var $radio = $('input[type="radio"][name="' + id + '"]');
    if ($radio.length) {
      $radio.each(function () { this.checked = String(this.value) === String(v); });
      $radio.filter(':checked').trigger('change');
      return;
    }
    var el = document.getElementById(id), s = sl(id);
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.type === 'checkbox') {
      el.checked = !!v;
    } else if (s) {
      quiet = true;
      try { s.update({ from: +v }); } finally { quiet = false; }
      $(el).data('immediate', true);        // no slider debounce: one batch
    } else {
      el.value = v;
    }
    try { $(el).trigger('change'); } finally { $(el).data('immediate', false); }
  }

  // starting values come from the page's own HTML (attributes, which updates
  // from Shiny or the user do not change)
  function resetPage(pane) {
    var tid = $(pane).find('.player-btn').first().data('target');
    if (tid) stop(tid);
    $(pane).find('input.js-range-slider').each(function () {
      if (!isTime(this.id)) setInput(this.id, this.getAttribute('data-from'));
    });
    $(pane).find('input[type="number"]').not('.fig-w').each(function () {
      setInput(this.id, this.defaultValue);
    });
    $(pane).find('input[type="checkbox"]').each(function () {
      setInput(this.id, this.defaultChecked);
    });
    $(pane).find('input[type="radio"]').each(function () {
      if (this.defaultChecked) setInput(this.name, this.value);
    });
    $(pane).find('.curve-pills .nav-link[data-value="1"]').tab('show');
    if (tid) setT(tid, 0);
  }

  $(document).on('click', '.page-reset', function () {
    this.blur();
    resetPage($(this).closest('.tab-pane')[0]);
  });
  $(document).on('click', '.page-preset', function () {
    this.blur();
    var set = $(this).data('set');
    Object.keys(set).forEach(function (id) { setInput(id, set[id]); });
  });

  // ---- other page behaviour -------------------------------------------------

  // dim the curve tabs that are not currently drawn
  function dimPills(prefix) {
    var n = +$('input[name="' + prefix + '_n_curves"]:checked').val() || 1;
    $('#' + prefix + '_sets a[data-value]').each(function () {
      $(this).toggleClass('curve-off', +$(this).attr('data-value') > n);
    });
  }
  $(document).on('change', 'input[name$="_n_curves"]', function () {
    dimPills(this.name.replace(/_n_curves$/, ''));
  });
  $('input[name$="_n_curves"]').each(function () {
    dimPills(this.name.replace(/_n_curves$/, ''));
  });

  // hiding one predator-prey plot widens the other: make Shiny re-measure it
  // (Shiny 1.8.1 to 1.13 re-measure only on 'shown'. No ':visible' filter:
  // a conditional panel with display: contents never counts as visible.)
  $(document).on('hidden', '.lv-plots > div', function () {
    $(this).siblings().trigger('shown');
  });
});
)")

## Server ######################################################################

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Plot sizes as the browser reports them. While a plot has no real size
  # (hidden, or mid-layout) nothing is drawn, instead of R failing on it.
  plot_dim <- function(id, dim) {
    function() {
      v <- session$clientData[[paste0("output_", id, "_", dim)]]
      req(isTRUE(v > 50))
      v
    }
  }
  # Each plot's static part: drawn on screen, and again for downloads.
  # The CSS sizes every plot (growth plots 17:9, capped by the window height).
  session$userData$overlays <- new.env() # what the browser draws on each plot
  session$userData$ov_sent <- new.env() # time slider id -> trajectories last sent
  fig_draw <- new.env() # plot output id -> function drawing its static part

  # TRUE from the first time one of these plots is on screen. A page's
  # trajectories are computed only from then on: under webR, computing every
  # page at start-up would delay the first one.
  seen <- function(ids) {
    shown <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
    obs <- observe({
      hidden <- lapply(ids, function(id) session$clientData[[paste0("output_", id, "_hidden")]])
      if (any(vapply(hidden, isFALSE, logical(1)))) {
        shown(TRUE)
        obs$destroy()
      }
    })
    shown
  }
  static_plot <- function(id, draw) {
    assign(id, draw, envir = fig_draw)
    # execOnResize: redraw rather than stretch the old picture, since tick
    # spacing and the phase-plane arrows depend on the plot's size
    output[[id]] <- renderPlot(draw(),
      width = plot_dim(id, "width"), height = plot_dim(id, "height"), res = plot_res,
      execOnResize = TRUE
    )
  }

  # discrete: time counts generations, so the slider moves in steps of 1
  sync_time_slider <- function(slider_id, tmax_id, discrete = FALSE) {
    observeEvent(input[[tmax_id]], {
      t_max <- input[[tmax_id]]
      t_now <- isolate(input[[slider_id]])
      step <- if (discrete) 1 else nice_step(t_max / 500)
      args <- list(session, slider_id, max = t_max, step = step)
      if (!is.null(t_now) && t_now > t_max) args$value <- t_max
      do.call(updateSliderInput, args)
    })
  }
  sync_time_slider("exp_t", "exp_tmax")
  sync_time_slider("log_t", "log_tmax")
  sync_time_slider("dexp_t", "dexp_tmax", discrete = TRUE)
  sync_time_slider("dlog_t", "dlog_tmax", discrete = TRUE)

  y_lim <- function(prefix) {
    lo <- input[[paste0(prefix, "_ymin")]]
    hi <- input[[paste0(prefix, "_ymax")]]
    ok <- is.numeric(lo) && is.numeric(hi) && !is.na(lo) && !is.na(hi) && hi > lo
    validate(need(ok, "Set y max above y min."))
    c(lo, hi)
  }

  # position of an optional reference line, or NULL while it is switched off
  user_line <- function(id) {
    if (!isTRUE(input[[paste0(id, "_on")]])) return(NULL)
    v <- input[[id]]
    if (is.numeric(v) && length(v) == 1 && is.finite(v)) v
  }

  # parameter sets of the curves currently shown, e.g. list(list(n0 =, r =), ...)
  curve_pars <- function(prefix, fields) {
    n <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(input[[paste0(prefix, "_n_curves")]]))
    if (length(n) == 0 || is.na(n)) n <- 1L
    lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
      p <- lapply(fields, function(f) as.numeric(input[[paste0(prefix, "_", f, "_", i)]]))
      names(p) <- fields
      do.call(req, unname(p))
      p
    })
  }

  # K of each curve shown, for the K lines. Reads nothing else, so changing
  # r or N0 does not redraw the plot's static part.
  curve_k <- function(prefix) {
    n <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(input[[paste0(prefix, "_n_curves")]]))
    if (length(n) == 0 || is.na(n)) n <- 1L
    vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) req(as.numeric(input[[paste0(prefix, "_k_", i)]])), numeric(1))
  }

  # choosing how many curves to show opens the tab of the last one
  for (prefix in c("exp", "log", "dlog")) {
    local({
      pf <- prefix
      observeEvent(input[[paste0(pf, "_n_curves")]],
        {
          updateTabsetPanel(session, paste0(pf, "_sets"), selected = input[[paste0(pf, "_n_curves")]])
        },
        ignoreInit = TRUE
      )
    })
  }

  # curves for the whole run; the browser shows them up to t
  send_growth <- function(time_id, out_id, tt, ys) {
    n <- length(ys)
    data <- c(list(t = tt), setNames(ys, paste0("y", seq_len(n))))
    send_overlay(session, time_id, data, list(list(
      id = out_id, blank0 = FALSE, values = TRUE, showT = TRUE, line = 0.5, seg = 2.2,
      series = lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
        list(x = "t", y = paste0("y", i), lty = curve_lty[i])
      }),
      items = lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
        list(
          label = "N", sub = if (n > 1) as.character(i) else "", lty = curve_lty[i],
          series = i - 1, coord = "y"
        )
      }),
      labels = list()
    )))
  }

  static_plot("exp_plot", function() {
    draw_growth(req(input$exp_tmax), y_lim("exp"),
      hline = user_line("exp_hline"), vline = user_line("exp_vline")
    )
  })

  exp_seen <- seen("exp_plot")
  observe({
    req(exp_seen())
    t_max <- req(input$exp_tmax)
    pars <- curve_pars("exp", c("n0", "r"))
    tt <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = 1001)
    send_growth("exp_t", "exp_plot", tt, lapply(pars, function(p) exp_n(tt, p$n0, p$r)))
  })

  static_plot("log_plot", function() {
    draw_growth(
      req(input$log_tmax), y_lim("log"),
      k = if (isTRUE(input$log_show_k)) curve_k("log"),
      right_mar = 2.8,
      hline = user_line("log_hline"), vline = user_line("log_vline")
    )
  })

  log_seen <- seen("log_plot")
  observe({
    req(log_seen())
    t_max <- req(input$log_tmax)
    pars <- curve_pars("log", c("n0", "r", "k"))
    tt <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = 1001)
    send_growth("log_t", "log_plot", tt, lapply(pars, function(p) log_n(tt, p$n0, p$r, p$k)))
  })

  ## Discrete time: exponential with noise ------------------------------------

  # Replicate runs keep their random draws while time moves or the view
  # changes; "New runs" draws a fresh set.
  # one seed per kind of noise, so each view shows the same runs
  dexp_seed <- reactiveVal(sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 2))
  observeEvent(input$dexp_new, dexp_seed(sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 2)))

  dexp_overlap <- function() !isTRUE(input$dexp_nonoverlap)
  dexp_view <- function() {
    v <- input$dexp_view
    if (is.null(v)) "det" else v
  }
  # Why these settings cannot be drawn ("" when they can). R is a mean number
  # of offspring, so it cannot be negative, except for the deterministic model
  # with overlapping generations, where R down to -1 is a net loss.
  # (a reactiveVal: the plots redraw only when the message changes, not with every R)
  dexp_msg <- reactiveVal("")
  observe(
    {
      r_ok <- isTRUE(input$dexp_r >= 0)
      dexp_msg(
        if (!dexp_overlap() && !r_ok) {
          paste(
            "With non-overlapping generations, N(t+1) = R N(t): R is the mean number",
            "of offspring per individual, so it cannot be negative. Set R to 0 or more."
          )
        } else if (dexp_view() != "det" && !r_ok) {
          paste(
            "With overlapping generations, parents never die and offspring are",
            "Poisson(R), so R cannot be negative. Set R to 0 or more, or use the",
            "deterministic view."
          )
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )
    },
    priority = 10
  )

  dexp_pars <- reactive(list(
    n0 = req(input$dexp_n0), r = req(input$dexp_r), t_max = req(input$dexp_tmax),
    overlapping = dexp_overlap()
  ))
  # replicate runs of one kind of noise (one column each): computed only
  # when a view shows them, and kept while the view changes
  dexp_sims <- lapply(c(dem = 1, env = 2), function(k) {
    noise <- c("demographic", "environmental")[k]
    reactive({
      p <- dexp_pars()
      runs <- req(input$dexp_runs)
      req(p$r >= 0)
      with_seed(dexp_seed()[k], matrix(
        vapply(
          seq_len(runs), function(i) dexp_run(p$n0, p$r, p$t_max, noise, p$overlapping),
          numeric(p$t_max + 1)
        ),
        nrow = p$t_max + 1
      ))
    })
  })
  # panel a, and panel b beside it for "both kinds"
  for (pn in c("a", "b")) {
    static_plot(paste0("dexp_plot_", pn), function() {
      validate(need(!nzchar(dexp_msg()), dexp_msg()))
      draw_growth(req(input$dexp_tmax), y_lim("dexp"),
        hline = user_line("dexp_hline"), vline = user_line("dexp_vline"),
        discrete = TRUE
      )
    })
  }

  # deterministic: dashed line and open circles (values written at the points);
  # with noise: grey runs, the deterministic curve in black, and read-outs of the
  # mean, the median and the share of runs that have died out (N = 0)
  dexp_seen <- seen("dexp_plot_a")
  observe({
    req(dexp_seen(), !nzchar(dexp_msg()))
    p <- dexp_pars()
    kinds <- switch(dexp_view(), det = character(0), both = c("dem", "env"), dexp_view())
    data <- list(t = 0:p$t_max, det = dexp_run(p$n0, p$r, p$t_max, "none", p$overlapping))
    runs <- 0
    for (kind in kinds) {
      m <- dexp_sims[[kind]]()
      runs <- ncol(m)
      data[[paste0(kind, "_mean")]] <- rowMeans(m)
      data[[paste0(kind, "_median")]] <- apply(m, 1, stats::median)
      data[[paste0(kind, "_extinct")]] <- round(100 * rowMeans(m == 0), 1)
      for (i in seq_len(runs)) data[[paste0(kind, "_", i)]] <- m[, i]
    }
    show_det <- isTRUE(input$dexp_det)
    det_cfg <- function(id) {
      list(
        id = id, blank0 = FALSE, values = TRUE, showT = TRUE, line = 0.5, seg = 2.2,
        series = list(list(x = "t", y = "det", lty = 2, lwd = 0.6, pch = "open")),
        items = list(list(label = "N", sub = "", lty = 0, series = 0, coord = "y")),
        labelSeries = if (isTRUE(input$dexp_labels)) 0 else -1, labels = list()
      )
    }
    noise_cfg <- function(id, kind, show_t = TRUE) {
      series <- c(
        if (show_det) list(list(x = "t", y = "det", lty = 1, lwd = 0.8, pch = "open")),
        lapply(seq_len(runs), function(i) {
          list(
            x = "t", y = paste0(kind, "_", i), lty = 2, col = "#a3a3a3", lwd = 0.45,
            pch = "hollow", ptScale = 0.6
          )
        }),
        list(
          list(x = "t", y = paste0(kind, "_mean"), draw = FALSE),
          list(x = "t", y = paste0(kind, "_median"), draw = FALSE),
          list(x = "t", y = paste0(kind, "_extinct"), draw = FALSE)
        )
      )
      k <- length(series)
      items <- c(
        if (show_det) {
          list(list(label = "N", sub = "", lty = 1, pch = "open", series = 0, coord = "y"))
        },
        list(
          list(label = "mean", plain = TRUE, sub = "", lty = 0, series = k - 3, coord = "y"),
          list(label = "median", plain = TRUE, sub = "", lty = 0, series = k - 2, coord = "y"),
          list(
            label = "extinct", plain = TRUE, sub = "", lty = 0, series = k - 1, coord = "y",
            suffix = "%"
          )
        )
      )
      list(
        id = id, blank0 = FALSE, values = TRUE, showT = show_t, line = 0.5, seg = 2.2,
        series = series, items = items, labelSeries = -1, labels = list(),
        title = if (kind == "dem") "Demographic stochasticity" else "Environmental stochasticity"
      )
    }
    outputs <- switch(dexp_view(),
      det = list(det_cfg("dexp_plot_a")),
      dem = list(noise_cfg("dexp_plot_a", "dem")),
      env = list(noise_cfg("dexp_plot_a", "env")),
      both = list(noise_cfg("dexp_plot_a", "dem"), noise_cfg("dexp_plot_b", "env", show_t = FALSE))
    )
    send_overlay(session, "dexp_t", data, outputs, discrete = TRUE)
  })

  ## Discrete time: logistic ----------------------------------------------------

  static_plot("dlog_plot", function() {
    draw_growth(
      req(input$dlog_tmax), y_lim("dlog"),
      k = if (isTRUE(input$dlog_show_k)) curve_k("dlog"),
      right_mar = 2.8,
      hline = user_line("dlog_hline"), vline = user_line("dlog_vline"),
      discrete = TRUE
    )
  })

  dlog_seen <- seen("dlog_plot")
  observe({
    req(dlog_seen())
    t_max <- req(input$dlog_tmax)
    pars <- curve_pars("dlog", c("n0", "r", "k"))
    n <- length(pars)
    ys <- lapply(pars, function(p) dlog_run(p$n0, p$r, p$k, t_max))
    data <- c(list(t = 0:t_max), setNames(ys, paste0("y", seq_len(n))))
    send_overlay(session, "dlog_t", data, list(list(
      id = "dlog_plot", blank0 = FALSE, values = TRUE, showT = TRUE, line = 0.5, seg = 2.2,
      series = lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
        list(x = "t", y = paste0("y", i), lty = dcurve_lty[i], lwd = 0.6, pch = dcurve_pch[i])
      }),
      items = lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
        list(
          label = "N", sub = if (n > 1) as.character(i) else "", lty = dcurve_lty[i],
          pch = dcurve_pch[i], series = i - 1, coord = "y"
        )
      }),
      labelSeries = -1, labels = list()
    )), discrete = TRUE)
  })

  ## Predator-prey pages: solved once per parameter change

  pp_server <- function(id, has_k, has_h) {
    force(id)
    force(has_k)
    force(has_h) # called in a loop: fix values now
    inp <- function(x) input[[paste0(id, "_", x)]]
    sync_time_slider(paste0(id, "_t"), paste0(id, "_tmax"))

    # K from the slider, or the typed value when "Set K by hand" is ticked
    # (NA while the typed value is not a number above 0)
    k_value <- function() {
      if (!has_k) return(Inf)
      if (isTRUE(inp("K_manual_on"))) {
        k <- inp("K_manual")
        return(if (is.numeric(k) && isTRUE(k > 0)) k else NA_real_)
      }
      inp("K")
    }

    pars <- reactive({
      p <- c(
        r = inp("r"), a = inp("a"), e = inp("e"), m = inp("m"),
        K = k_value(),
        h = if (has_h) inp("h") else 0
      )
      req(length(p) == 6)
      p
    })

    # the trajectory, or NULL when the solver fails
    sol <- reactive({
      req(inp("tmax"), !is.null(inp("n0")), !is.null(inp("p0")))
      out <- tryCatch(lv_solve(inp("n0"), inp("p0"), pars(), inp("tmax")),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(out) && all(is.finite(out$N), is.finite(out$P))) out
    })

    time_out <- paste0(id, "_time_plot")
    phase_out <- paste0(id, "_phase_plot")
    shown <- seen(c(time_out, phase_out))

    # Why the model cannot be drawn ("" when it can), shown on both plots.
    # (a reactiveVal: the plots redraw only when the message changes)
    pp_msg <- reactiveVal("")

    static_plot(time_out, function() {
      validate(need(!nzchar(pp_msg()), pp_msg()))
      draw_lv_time(req(inp("tmax")), y_lim(id),
        hline = user_line(paste0(id, "_time_hline")),
        vline = user_line(paste0(id, "_time_vline"))
      )
    })

    # pars() is read only with isoclines or arrows, so that otherwise moving a
    # parameter does not redraw the phase plane
    static_plot(phase_out, function() {
      validate(need(!nzchar(pp_msg()), pp_msg()))
      n_max <- inp("nmax")
      p_max <- inp("pmax")
      validate(need(isTRUE(n_max > 0) && isTRUE(p_max > 0), "Set N max and P max above 0."))
      show_iso <- isTRUE(inp("iso"))
      show_field <- isTRUE(inp("field"))
      draw_lv_phase(
        xlim = c(0, n_max), ylim = c(0, p_max), pars = if (show_iso || show_field) pars(),
        show_iso = show_iso, show_field = show_field,
        readout = identical(inp("view"), "phase"),
        hline = user_line(paste0(id, "_phase_hline")),
        vline = user_line(paste0(id, "_phase_vline"))
      )
    })

    # trajectory for the whole run; N solid and P dashed in time, orbit in the plane
    # (runs before the plots, so they see the new message)
    observe(
      {
        req(shown())
        p <- pars()
        s <- if (!is.na(p[["K"]])) sol()
        pp_msg(
          if (is.na(p[["K"]])) {
            "Set K above 0."
          } else if (is.null(s)) {
            "The solver could not integrate these parameters."
          } else {
            ""
          }
        )
        if (is.null(s)) {
          clear_overlay(session, paste0(id, "_t"), c(time_out, phase_out))
          return()
        }
        phase_only <- identical(inp("view"), "phase")
        send_overlay(session, paste0(id, "_t"), list(t = s$t, N = s$N, P = s$P), list(
          list(
            id = paste0(id, "_time_plot"), blank0 = TRUE, values = TRUE, showT = TRUE,
            line = 0.5, seg = 1.8,
            series = list(list(x = "t", y = "N", lty = 1), list(x = "t", y = "P", lty = 2)),
            items = list(
              list(label = "N", sub = "", lty = 1, series = 0, coord = "y"),
              list(label = "P", sub = "", lty = 2, series = 1, coord = "y")
            ),
            labels = list()
          ),
          list(
            id = paste0(id, "_phase_plot"), blank0 = TRUE, values = phase_only,
            showT = phase_only, line = 1.5, seg = 0,
            series = list(list(x = "N", y = "P", lty = 1)),
            items = list(
              list(label = "N", sub = "", lty = 0, series = 0, coord = "x"),
              list(label = "P", sub = "", lty = 0, series = 0, coord = "y")
            ),
            labels = if (isTRUE(inp("iso"))) intercept_labels(p) else list()
          )
        ))
      },
      priority = 10
    )
  }

  for (pg in pp_pages) pp_server(pg$id, pg$has_k, pg$has_h)

  ## Downloads: the plots in view, redrawn by R at the browser's t -------------

  page_names <- c(
    exp = "exponential", log = "logistic",
    dexp = "discrete-exponential", dlog = "discrete-logistic",
    setNames(
      vapply(pp_pages, function(p) tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", p$title)), ""),
      vapply(pp_pages, `[[`, "", "id")
    )
  )

  observeEvent(input$fig_request, {
    rq <- input$fig_request
    ids <- as.character(unlist(rq$ids))
    w <- as.numeric(unlist(rq$w))
    h <- as.numeric(unlist(rq$h))
    t <- as.numeric(rq$t)
    fmt <- if (identical(rq$fmt, "pdf")) "pdf" else "png"
    w_cm <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rq$w_cm))
    if (length(w_cm) == 1 && isTRUE(w_cm > 0) && (w_cm < 3 || w_cm > 100)) {
      showNotification("Figure width: give 3 to 100 cm, or leave it empty.", type = "warning")
      return()
    }
    if (fmt == "png" && isTRUE(w_cm > fig_png_max_cm)) {
      showNotification(sprintf("PNG: up to %s cm wide. Use PDF for a wider figure.", fig_png_max_cm),
        type = "warning"
      )
      return()
    }
    width_in <- if (length(w_cm) == 1 && isTRUE(w_cm >= 3)) w_cm / 2.54
    if (!length(ids) || !all(ids %in% ls(fig_draw)) || length(t) != 1 || !is.finite(t)) {
      showNotification("Nothing to save yet.", type = "warning")
      return()
    }

    page <- sub("_t$", "", rq$time)
    view <- if (page == "dexp") {
      c(det = "", dem = "-demographic", env = "-environmental", both = "")[[dexp_view()]]
    } else if (length(ids) == 1 && grepl("_(time|phase)_plot$", ids)) {
      paste0("-", sub("^.*_(time|phase)_plot$", "\\1", ids))
    } else {
      ""
    }
    discrete <- page %in% c("dexp", "dlog")
    t_txt <- if (discrete) sprintf("%d", as.integer(round(t))) else sub("\\.?0+$", "", sprintf("%.2f", t))
    name <- paste0(page_names[[page]] %||% page, view, "_t", t_txt, ".", fmt)

    path <- tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", fmt))
    ok <- tryCatch(
      {
        write_figure(path, fmt,
          draws = lapply(ids, get, envir = fig_draw),
          overlays = lapply(ids, function(id) session$userData$overlays[[id]]),
          w = w, h = h, t = t, width_in = width_in
        )
        TRUE
      },
      fig_too_narrow = function(e) {
        showNotification(conditionMessage(e), type = "warning")
        FALSE
      },
      error = function(e) {
        msg <- conditionMessage(e)
        showNotification(paste("Could not save the figure:", if (nzchar(msg)) msg else "the plot is not ready."),
          type = "error"
        )
        FALSE
      }
    )
    if (!ok) return()
    bytes <- readBin(path, "raw", file.info(path)$size)
    unlink(path)
    session$sendCustomMessage("fig-file", list(
      name = name,
      mime = if (fmt == "pdf") "application/pdf" else "image/png",
      data = jsonlite::base64_enc(bytes)
    ))
  })
}

# Population dynamics teaching app

Interactive Shiny app for Piotr Michalak's population-dynamics workshops
(University of Toulouse). Everything is in one file, `app.R`.

**Roles.** Piotr designs it (models, features, plot style, defaults, code tweaks). Claude writes the main code. Keep the credit line on the page exactly as it is:
"© 2026 Piotr Michalak · app R code under MIT licence / Designed by Piotr Michalak /
Code written with Claude (Anthropic)". Keep the MIT header in `app.R`.

## Workflow

- This repo holds the source only. The stable version students use is a Shinylive
  export in a different repo (Piotr's website). Releasing means that export, and
  Piotr does it by hand: `shinylive::export("<app folder>", "<site folder>")`.
  Never modify the site or set up automatic deploys.
- Claude has no write access to GitHub. Read the current app.R from the repo (or ask Piotr to attach it), then hand back a new app.R or a patch. Piotr commits it.
- Run locally with `Rscript -e 'shiny::runApp("app.R", launch.browser = FALSE)'`.  FreeBSD R fails starting the browser. 

## Hard constraints

- **Shinylive (webR) compatible.** Base R plus shiny only (bslib and jsonlite
  come with it). No deSolve and no other extra packages: ODEs use the built-in
  `ode_dp5()`. webR is several times slower than native R, so keep R work per
  slider change small.
- **Works on old and new Shiny.** Test on Shiny 1.8 and ≥ 1.14. Newer Shiny gives
  `conditionalPanel` `display: contents`, which changes layout and sizing; the CSS
  sizes both `.lv-plots > div` and `.lv-plots .ov-wrap` for that reason.
- **No page scrolling at 1280×800**, in every page and view. The player row
  must stay on one line at 1024 px. Check `document.documentElement.scrollHeight`.
- No R warnings in the console, no JS errors.

## Architecture

- **R draws the static part** of each plot (axes, reference lines, isoclines,
  arrows) through `static_plot(id, draw)`. **The browser draws what moves with
  time** on a canvas overlay (`render()` in `player_js`), positioned from Shiny's
  coordmap. R sends each trajectory once with `send_overlay()`, and playback uses
  `requestAnimationFrame`. Playback and scrubbing must never wait for R.
- **Downloads (PNG/PDF):** R redraws the whole figure. `draw_overlay()` is R's
  twin of the JS `render()`, so any change to one must be made in the other.
  `write_figure()` writes the file, which goes to the browser via the
  `fig-file` custom message. Don't use `downloadHandler` (untested under Shinylive).
  The width box sets the figure width in cm; text keeps its point size.
- **A static plot reads only the inputs it draws.** Otherwise every slider move
  re-renders an image for nothing, which is slow under webR. Examples:
  `curve_k()` reads only K; `dexp_msg` is a `reactiveVal`, so it only invalidates
  when the message changes.
- `renderPlot(..., execOnResize = TRUE)`: tick spacing and the phase-plane arrows
  depend on plot size, so replaying the old drawing at a new size is wrong.
- Plot width and height come from `plot_dim()`, which `req()`s a real size
  (avoids "invalid 'width' argument" while a plot is hidden or mid-layout).

## Plot style

- Base graphics, `bty = "l"`, axes drawn with `lwd = 0` and tick marks only.
- Reference lines (y = 0, K) dotted (`lty = 3`), grey; optional user
  reference lines grey45, `lty = 5`.
- Font Gillius ADF (`plot_font`); style constants sit at the top of `app.R`.
- Curves 1–3: solid, dashed, dotted. Discrete pages: open circle, filled
  circle, open triangle markers.

## Defaults matter for teaching

- The y axis is fixed by the user (y min / y max), never auto-scaled: noticing
  that the axis must be extended is part of the lesson.
- Off by default: K lines, isoclines, phase arrows, user reference lines.
- Predator–prey pages start blank at t = 0 (only the starting dots).
- Exponential default r = 0.5, 0, −0.5; Lotka–Volterra N₀ = 20, P₀ = 2.

## Model conventions

- Predator–prey: dN/dt = rN(1 − N/K) − aNP/(1 + ahN), dP/dt = eaNP/(1 + ahN) − mP
  (K = ∞ and/or h = 0 on the simpler pages; "Set K by hand" on logistic-prey pages).
- Discrete exponential: **R is the mean number of offspring per individual per
  generation.** Overlapping generations (parents survive, as in the lecture C
  programs): N(t+1) = N(t) + R N(t). Non-overlapping: N(t+1) = R N(t).
  Demographic noise: Poisson(R) offspring per individual (drawn as one
  Poisson(R N)); environmental noise: one Poisson(R) multiplier shared by all.
  R < 0 only makes sense for the overlapping deterministic model (net loss).
  Each noise type has its own seed, so the runs match across views.
- Discrete logistic: N(t+1) = N(t) + R N(t)(1 − N(t)/K), clamped at 0.

## Testing

Use Playwright with the preinstalled Chromium, and a real browser check before
handing anything back. Useful habits:

- Set sliders with `$('#id').data('ionRangeSlider').update({from: v})` and then
  trigger `change`.
- Wait for `#<output> img` before interacting.
- Screenshot the views you touched.
- For downloads, compare the saved PNG/PDF with the screen.
- For models, check numbers against theory (branching-process extinction,
  equilibria, periods) rather than by eye.
